notes: Routes are assigned from the audited call contract, never from the directory name alone.
direct: the audited AsNumpy surface (plus documented equivalences) is expected to migrate and verify.
gap: the program exercises a contract outside the audited surface; a clean gap stop honours it, and closing it is recorded as improved.
audit: the migration cannot be counted as direct until the listed semantic audit is explicitly resolved.
reject: the program must be refused statically and never executed.

A_direct_simple.rationale: Elementwise, reduction and matmul calls are inside the audited surface.

B_direct_semantics.rationale: Semantic traps are direct only when the argument contract is audited; out/where/casting and alias mutation are overridden below.

C_direct_structure.rationale: Reachable helpers and static control flow are inlined by the deterministic benchmark lowering before analysis.

D1_partial_low_kernel.rationale: A small number of APIs outside the pinned export surface are inserted into an otherwise direct program.

D2_partial_low_official.rationale: Alias and combination calls are documented equivalences already exercised by the product.

E_partial_high.rationale: Multiple missing APIs and structural constraints require gap filling before any direct claim.

F_partial_consent.rationale: Keyword signatures differ from the pinned AsNumpy snapshot; rewriting requires explicit consent, not a silent mapping.

G_partial_dedup.rationale: The same gap contract appears at three static call sites and must be resolved as one contract.

H_gap_official.rationale: Alias and composition cases are gap-class until the documented composition or official overlay is proven for the exact contract.

I_gap_model.rationale: One missing API per case with explicit boundary inputs; model-backed gap filling is required.

J_out_of_subset.rationale: Dynamic execution, I/O, concurrency, callbacks and special dtypes are outside the supported subset.

K_gap_all.rationale: Multi-stage programs combine several gap contracts and call sites.

B001_out_buffer.rationale: The pinned AsNumpy reader rejects the out= keyword; a rewrite needs explicit consent.

B002_where_preserves.rationale: The pinned AsNumpy reader rejects the out= and where= keywords; masked in-place semantics cannot be silently rewritten.

B003_unsafe_cast.rationale: casting= changes overflow behaviour; mapping it silently would change semantics.

B014_overlapping_alias.rationale: The source mutates one view of an overlapping pair; a rebinding rewrite loses the observable mutation of the alias output and must not be counted as direct.

B019_boolean_keepdims.rationale: Negative axis is normalized to the audited single-element integer tuple contract.

D1001_signed_compression.rationale: cbrt is outside the export surface; the documented copysign/power composition closes the gap and is recorded as improved.

G004_cbrt_three_channels.rationale: Three cbrt call sites share one contract; the documented composition closes all three at once.

I001_cube_root.rationale: cbrt is absent from the pinned exports; the signed composition closes it without a new kernel.

I003_nan_classification.rationale: isnan is absent from the pinned exports; not_equal(x, x) is an exact composition for real floats.
